'''Lurinn''' were [[Viska (species)|Viska]] clans that had been nominated by the [[caleisk]] to preside over the [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[City/Legends|cities]]. Each lurinn was ruled over by a [[calsk]].
